title: Representative Introductory Programming Benchmark
learningOutcomes: Write small programs using variables, expressions, conditionals, loops, and functions.
Use basic data structures to model and transform information.
Debug and test programs using repeatable techniques.
Read and write simple files while explaining program behavior.
